about: Kliovance (oral oestradiol with norethisterone) is supplied five times from March to July 2026 for a woman aged 67, by brand name only.
Premarin (conjugated oestrogens by mouth) is supplied four times in the middle of a 14-month history for a woman aged 70.
Vagifem Low (oestradiol vaginal pessaries) is supplied three times. It is placed in the vagina, not taken by mouth, so nothing must flag.
